findings.body: `mkdirSync(requested, { recursive: true })` runs before either the task root or requested path is canonicalized. For a path such as `<trusted-temp>/3f-financial-X/link/new`, where `link` is a junction into a registered worktree, the lexical check passes and this line creates `new` inside the worktree before the later canonical checks throw. The new evidence beyond the prior junction ruling is the nonexistent child below an existing junction; the added test exercises only the junction itself, where `mkdirSync` performs no write. Canonicalize and validate the nearest existing ancestor before creating anything, and test that a child under a junction is rejected without creating the child.
findings.title: Validate nested junction paths before creating artifact directories

findings.body: This committed Forge task-state file remains outside LEGACY-UI's permitted paths and is not needed for the Playwright setup or baseline proof. It also records obsolete blocking findings and leaves the task in `fixing` state after the corresponding implementation changed, so it is stale workflow state rather than a deliverable. Remove it from the branch.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope task-state artifact
